title: Ramsey number R(4,15), lower bound
statement: Find a two-colouring of the edges of K_n with no red K_4 and no blue K_15; it shows R(4,15) > n. The best known lower bound is R(4,15) >= 163, so a colouring of K_162 is known and one of K_163 or more would improve it.
submission: Text file: the n x n adjacency matrix of the red graph, one line of n characters 0/1 per vertex (1 red, 0 blue), symmetric with a zero diagonal; n <= 2048.

best_known.source: R(4,15) >= 163: NaRT repository, 22 Oct 2026; Small Ramsey Numbers rev. 18 printed 159; read 5 Nov 2026
